existing_rows_audit.detail: The Paris office exists and is hiring (13 live reqs firmwide), but no req is titled 'Quantitative Strategist' there. The live Paris quant seats are 'Risk - Quantitative Engineer - Associate - Paris' (https://higher.gs.com/roles/174397), 'Risk - Quantitative Engineering - Vice President - Paris' (https://higher.gs.com/roles/157331) and 'Global Banking & Markets, FICCs Credit Strats – Embedded Control Strat - Associate - Paris' (https://higher.gs.com/roles/157351). GS files these under the job function 'Quantitative Engineering', not 'Quantitative Strategist'.

Separate data-quality flag on the same row: its 'Stated Requirements' cell reads 'English-language seat in Tokyo; JP language not required in strats' - Tokyo text pasted into a Paris row. That bullet is wrong for Paris and should be removed. Nothing about the Paris postings mentions Tokyo or language requirements.

The Tokyo (Minato-Ku) office is confirmed with 48 live reqs, but as of 2026-08-04 there is no Strats or Quantitative Engineering req open in Tokyo on https://higher.gs.com. The nearest live equivalents are 'FICC e-trading Engineer, Associate, Tokyo' (https://higher.gs.com/roles/177052) and 'FICC, Systematic Market Making Rates Trading, Analyst/Associate, Tokyo/Hong Kong' (https://higher.gs.com/roles/155223). The row's claim that JP language is not required does hold for those two - neither posting mentions Japanese - but two other Tokyo trading reqs do gate on Japanese, so the claim is not true of Tokyo generally.

notes:
Method: higher.gs.com is a JS-only Next.js app whose HTML shell contains no listings, so I queried its own public GraphQL API directly at https://api-higher.gs.com/gateway/api/v1/graphql (the endpoint the site's own client uses) and enumerated the complete req set - 1100 professional/early-career reqs plus 144 campus reqs - then read each shortlisted posting's full description from its public https://higher.gs.com/roles/<id> page. Every role above was read on GS's own site; all are status POSTED. Coverage should be complete for the in-scope locations rather than a sample.

Office confirmation comes from GS's own location filter on the same API. In-scope EU/UK cities with live reqs: London (97), Birmingham (38), Warsaw (39), Frankfurt/Munich (18), Paris (13), Dublin (5), The Hague (3), Milan (2), Zurich (4), Geneva (4), Stockholm (1), Copenhagen (1), Madrid (1). Asia: Hong Kong (87), Tokyo (48), Singapore (67), Shanghai (7). GS has no Amsterdam, Zug, Luxembourg, Brussels or Lisbon presence in its careers location list - the Netherlands seat is The Hague, and Switzerland is Zurich and Geneva only.

Compensation: no in-scope posting states a salary. GS publishes salary ranges only on US reqs (New York postings show base bands) because of US pay-transparency law. All comp_local fields are therefore empty by design, not by omission.

One req could not be verified: a Hong Kong 'Equities Quantitative Risk Engineer, Associate/Vice President' appears in the API search results under an internal UUID rather than a numeric id, and https://higher.gs.com/roles/<uuid> returns no role object, so I excluded it rather than guess at a URL.

Structural note on GS hiring for this candidate: GS runs two separate funnels. The campus funnel (144 reqs) is hard-gated on graduation year - the in-scope quant entries are all '2027 | APEJ | Singapore/Hong Kong | FICC and Equities (Sales and Trading) Quantitative Strats' analyst and summer roles, plus a 2026 'The Hague | Asset and Wealth Management Quantitative Strats' internship - and a Feb-2026 MSc graduate is outside all of them. Everything in the roles list above is from the lateral funnel, which has no year gate. Within that funnel the practical eligibility split is: genuinely open at your level are 157703 (London Applied AI, 1-3 yrs), 155286 (HK Equity Quant Research, 1+ yr preferred), 177222 (HK GSET, 1 yr minimum), 155223 (Tokyo/HK SMM Rates, explicitly junior), 175884 (London STS Trading), 164535 (London Fund Finance Strats), 160095 and 160094 (HK, no experience floor stated), and 177052 (Tokyo e-trading, no floor stated). Reaches or hard gates: 157332/157331 (PhD+5 or MSc+8, team management), 162208 (8 yrs preferred), 179463 (3 yrs markets), 167477 (native Japanese), 139649 (1 yr sell-side derivatives trading), 171765 (3+ yrs), 171766 (6+ yrs).

Language/visa: no in-scope posting outside Tokyo mentions a local-language requirement. The two Mainland-China-touching reqs (179048 Hong Kong/Shanghai, 164200 Shanghai) are posted wholly in English with no Mandarin clause, which makes them plausible English-tolerant exceptions, but I could not confirm that beyond the posting text and would treat it as unverified. In Tokyo, 167477 requires native Japanese and 139649 lists Japanese as a plus, while the two engineering/systematic seats (177052, 155223) mention no language requirement at all.
